desc.nodePath: Auto prefers the Node DSH ships, then PATH.
desc.command: Command name on PATH, or an absolute path of "playwright-cli.js".
desc.session: playwright-cli -s= name; every DSH session shares it.
desc.timeoutMs: Per-call timeout for one CLI invocation.
desc.requestTimeoutMs: How long a tool waits for the page half to answer.
desc.attachTimeoutMs: How long the CLI may take to attach before one retry.
desc.screenshotSettleMs: Wait for a first frame after focusing a hidden tab.
desc.autoAttach: Attach once when DSH starts, so sidebar pages opened afterwards are visible to the CLI. Costs one daemon process while DSH runs; only one DSH instance at a time.
desc.showSharedBadge: Show a small "driven by the agent" badge above the sidebar while the browser tab in view is controlled by this plugin. Nothing is painted into the page, and the badge ignores pointer events.
desc.debug: Print bridge and CLI diagnostics to the host log.
desc.disabledTools: Comma-separated tool names to leave unregistered (e.g. browser_console, browser_press). Empty keeps all 12 tools. Takes effect after the plugin row is re-enabled.
